description: This file contains a React functional component 'ViewDetailsModal' which renders a modal displaying details of an arbitrary JSON object. It formats labels, handles special display for user cost keys, and uses several utility functions for formatting currency and labels. The component is designed to be reusable across the application for various data viewing purposes.

methods.name: ViewDetailsModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal to display JSON data, with formatting for labels and special handling for user cost fields.

methods.name: renderValue
methods.description: Helper function to convert a value into a display string or React element, with custom formatting for user cost keys.

methods.name: toNumberLike
methods.description: Converts a value to a number using parseUsdToNumber utility.

methods.name: isUserCostKeyLoose
methods.description: Detects if a key string is related to user cost using regex matching.
